principle: Everything under site/ (including site/operator/**) is PUBLIC. No login exists on GitHub Pages. This contract defines what may therefore live in PUBLIC_SAFE_OPERATOR today, versus what is reserved for a future PRIVATE_OPERATOR that requires authentication and is NOT implemented on GitHub Pages this phase.

PUBLIC_SAFE_OPERATOR.deployment: site/operator/** via intel/operator_workspace/operator_ui.py, built at CI/build time, served as static HTML by GitHub Pages
allowed_contents: Report status (version, readiness, generated_at, html/pdf status)
Evidence relation status (connected/not connected counts, IDs)
Known Gaps (gap_type, topic, status, environment, next_possible_action if known)
Rights status (RIGHTS_STATUS/ACCESS_STATUS/FULLTEXT_ALLOWED/LINK_ONLY labels, never full text)
Source Health (per-source access_result, environment, last check, never credentials)
Research/Statistics metadata (title, authors, publication_date, identifier, source_url)
Public-safe diagnostics (e.g. build counts, NOT_INSTRUMENTED markers)
forbidden_contents: Internal acquisition diagnostics beyond public-safe status labels
API keys, tokens, credentials, cookies, authorization headers

PRIVATE_OPERATOR.deployment_target: future auth-gated environment, never GitHub Pages as-is
reserved_contents: Internal acquisition diagnostics (raw request/response logs, failure internals)
Manual approve/reject workflow for candidate evidence
PRIVATE_OPERATOR.implementation_note: No login system is built this phase (forbidden by Section 57). This contract exists so a future phase can wire auth without redesigning the data boundary.

direction_rule.OPERATOR_TO_PUBLIC_LINKS: ALLOWED (e.g. Operator Reports page links to the Public Intelligence Page)
direction_rule.PUBLIC_TO_OPERATOR_LINKS: FORBIDDEN_BY_DEFAULT (verified: no Public intelligence page links to /operator/ as of N-7)

verification_n7.secret_scan_of_site_operator: no API keys / tokens / secrets / private_research full_text / cookies / authorization headers found in site/operator/** (grep-based scan, N-7)
verification_n7.public_nav_operator_link: not present in site/index.html or site/intelligence/** (verified N-7)
verification_n7.operator_overview_banner: METAXIS OPERATOR / PUBLIC-SAFE OPERATIONS VIEW banner added to render_overview() in operator_ui.py, N-7
